basics.name: Seok-Jin Kang
basics.label: Scientist
basics.summary: Postdoctoral fellow at Korea University, working on data-driven immunology and therapeutic design using AI, multi-omics, and quantum-inspired modeling

projects.name: Safety Evaluation of Viral Vector-Based Gene Therapy
projects.entity: Ministry of Food and Drug Safety
projects.summary: Research Assistant (PI: Taehoon Chun). Conducted wet-lab and computational analyses to evaluate vector integration safety. Prepared and optimized whole-genome sequencing (WGS) libraries, followed by NGS data acquisition. Performed multi-omics integration and genomic correlation analyses to identify off-target insertion events.
highlights: Multi-omics integration and genomic correlation analysis
Safety profiling examining dose, administration route, and vector type

projects.name: HLA Gene Editing for Allogeneic Stem Cell Therapy
projects.summary: Research Assistant (PI: Dongho Geum). Designed and established HLA-edited induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs) for generating hypoimmunogenic cell lines. Conducted differentiation experiments and performed in vivo validation using mouse models.
highlights: In vivo immune compatibility and engraftment efficiency assessment

projects.name: Regulation of Immune Cell Differentiation by Chromatin 3D Structural Changes
projects.summary: Research Assistant (PI: Taehoon Chun). Investigated chromatin 3D structural reorganization mediated by the chromatin looper LDB1 regulating transcriptional programs across immune cell types. Conducted multi-omics integration and applied deep learning-based structural bioinformatics.
highlights: Deep learning for chromatin loop prediction

projects.name: Development of Universal SARS-CoV-2 and Sarbecovirus Vaccine Using NDV Vector Platform
projects.summary: Research Assistant (PI: Kisoon Kim). Modeled viral antigen epitopes using computational structural biology (AlphaFold) to enhance cross-neutralizing immune responses. Conducted in vitro and in vivo immunogenicity evaluations using animal models.
highlights: In vitro and in vivo immunogenicity evaluation
Vaccine-induced response analysis via ELISA and flow cytometry

projects.name: Development of Cellular Immune Evaluation Technology for Viral Vector-Based Genetic Vaccines
projects.entity: Ministry of Food and Drug Safety
projects.summary: Research Assistant (PI: Taehoon Chun). Designed AI-assisted pipelines for predicting TCR-peptide-MHC interactions and validated cellular responses experimentally using ELISPOT and flow cytometry.

projects.name: Mechanistic Study of Macrophage Polarization Regulated by Chromatin Remodeling Factor Phc2
projects.summary: Research Assistant (PI: Taehoon Chun). Performed transcriptomic profiling of macrophages under distinct polarization states. Applied machine learning-based differential expression and pathway analysis to identify Phc2-dependent networks.

projects.name: Development of DNA Markers to Enhance Resistance Against Chronic Wasting Diseases
projects.summary: Research Assistant (PI: Taehoon Chun). Conducted sequence analysis and SNP genotyping to identify host resistance markers. Developed computational pipelines using R and Python for comparative genomics.
highlights: Computational pipelines in R and Python

projects.name: Development of Novel Immune Cell Therapy Targeting Multiple Myeloma
projects.summary: Research Assistant (PI: Taehoon Chun). Designed and optimized chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) constructs through protein engineering and molecular cloning. Selected target-binding proteins based on affinity and specificity, and measured binding kinetics (Kd) using surface plasmon resonance (SPR).

projects.name: Production and Efficacy Evaluation of Novel Recombinant Immunotherapeutics
projects.summary: Research Assistant (PI: Taehoon Chun). Produced recombinant therapeutic proteins via molecular cloning and protein purification. Evaluated binding affinity using SPR and ELISA assays.
highlights: SPR and ELISA for binding affinity evaluation

projects.name: Screening of Immune-Enhancing Probiotics Using Immunodeficient Mouse Models
projects.summary: Research Assistant (PI: Taehoon Chun). Conducted animal experiments and analyzed cytokine profiles via flow cytometry and qPCR. Applied statistical analysis in R to evaluate immune enhancement.
highlights: Cytokine profiling via flow cytometry and qPCR
Statistical analysis for immune enhancement evaluation

projects.name: Determination of Dosing Period and Amount of Probiotics for Alleviating Allergic Rhinitis
projects.summary: Research Assistant (PI: Taehoon Chun). Evaluated probiotic-induced modulation of Th1/Th2 cytokine ratios using ELISA and gene expression profiling. Applied statistical modeling to identify optimal dosing.

projects.name: Development of Genetic Markers Associated to the Resistance to PMWS
projects.summary: Research Assistant (PI: Taehoon Chun). Performed comparative genomics and sequence-based variant analysis. Utilized bioinformatics tools (Biopython, BLAST) to detect resistance-associated mutations.

projects.name: Selection and In Vivo Efficacy Verification of Probiotics with Enhanced IgA Secretion
projects.summary: Research Assistant (PI: Taehoon Chun). Measured mucosal IgA levels in mouse models and identified strains with strong immunostimulatory potential. Applied bioinformatics analysis of gene expression and immune pathway mapping.
highlights: Mucosal IgA measurement in mouse models
Gene expression and immune pathway analysis
